rv.q: The production might be tiny, but it is a gem.

My turmoil is offset, however, by my appreciation of a magnificent piece of musical theater, brilliantly produced and superbly played by a cast whose acting ability is matched only by their musical genius.
Their Sweeney is unique and moving from start to finish and works brilliantly even without some of the expected physical elements.
Miscasting aside, there is more than enough to recommend this Sweeney.

cn.t: Kokandy's intimate basement production of Sweeney Todd proves that small-scale stagings can shine, with critics praising its creative approach and dark, ruthless depiction of corruption despite less polished elements.
